registration-form.file_date: The date on which the form was signed or dated by its signer, as written beside the signature (for example 'the 5th day of March, 2012'). It is not a received or filed stamp.
registration-form.foreign_principle_name: The foreign principle name refers to the name of the individual or entity that holds foreign ownership or control over the registrant.
registration-form.registrant_name: The name of the organisation (firm, company or office) that files the registration, not the name of the person who signs it.
registration-form.registration_num: Registration number associated with the document.
registration-form.signer_name: The full name of the person who signs the document, written without their title or position.
registration-form.signer_title: The signer_title field holds the title or position of the person who signed the document.
